purpose: Teach: 丞/濱/荒野/北西/南海/会津/準々/ペニス

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、丞、つまり古代官位「丞」の制度研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the ancient bureaucratic rank system of jou, didn't you.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Measured pace. A gentle assumption — not testing, inviting confirmation. Soft eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、旧字「濱」、つまり浜の地名表記の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on the historical usage of the old character for hama, the place-name writing system.
lines.style: Polite, slightly formal. Quiet concentration. Correcting gently without defensiveness. The careful student clarifying what he actually studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、北海道の荒野、つまり原野の開拓史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of development in Hokkaido's frontier regions, didn't you.
lines.style: Same warm tone as first line. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine interest in hearing what he'll clarify this time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、北西気候、つまり北西季節風の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on the research of northwestern seasonal winds and their climatic patterns.
lines.style: Same polite, clarifying register. A small breath before beginning. The rhythm of patient, repeated correction without frustration.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、南海トラフ地震の予測研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on earthquake prediction research for the Nankai Trough, didn't you.
lines.style: Same opening warmth. Slight lift in the voice — testing gently if this one will also be corrected. Curious now, genuinely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、会津藩の戊辰戦争の社会史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on the social history of the Boshin War in the Aizu Domain.
lines.style: Unchanged polite correction. Calm. The student is not annoyed at being misunderstood; he's simply stating what he actually wrote.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高校野球の準々決勝の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on a sociological study of high school baseball quarterfinals, didn't you.
lines.style: Same warm, inviting tone. A hint of amusement now — Asuka realises the pattern. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、男性器、つまりペニスに関する泌尿器科の臨床研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote my paper on a clinical urology study regarding male anatomy and physiology.
lines.style: Same earnest register, but delivered with quiet directness. No embarrassment, no evasion. Clinical precision in the phrasing. Steady eye contact.
